message:
ok for locked out users: go to the admin console, find the user, hit reset mfa (NOT reset password, that doesn't clear their old phone!!). they get an email to enroll again. oh and make sure it's actually them first, call the number in the HR system, don't trust the one in the ticket. check the log after. contractors are a different process, ask IAM

can someone please write this down properly. third time this month i've explained it

answer.label: How-to
answer.title: Reset MFA for a <f1>locked-out user</f1>

items.text: <f8>Confirm that the request is genuine.</f8> <f9>Call the user on the number in the HR system</f9>, <f10>not the number in the ticket</f10>.
<f12>Contractor accounts follow a different process.</f12> <f13>Ask the IAM team.</f13>

items.caution: **Caution:** <f5>Don't select **Reset password**.</f5> <f6>It doesn't clear the user's old phone.</f6>

items.text: Tell the user to expect an <f7>email to enroll again</f7>.

facts.quote: call the number in the HR system
don't trust the one in the ticket
